-- Rotate an 8-bit value left by k bits (k from 0 to 7),
-- wrapping the high bits around to the low end.
--
-- BLOCKED: the Yan reference I was given does not name any way to
-- convert between u8 and int. Four guesses have been rejected by
-- the checker: int(x), x.to_int(), to_u8(...), and the
-- to_int_from_u8 / to_u8_from_int pair. Inventing another name
-- would only repeat the failure, so the body below is left as a
-- marked placeholder. Replace the two UNVERIFIED lines with the
-- real conversion API once it is confirmed.
rotl8(x: u8, k: int) -> u8 =
  pre k >= 0
  pre k <= 7
  ex rotl8(129, 1) == 3
  ex rotl8(1, 0) == 1
  ex rotl8(128, 7) == 64
  let n = UNVERIFIED_u8_to_int(x)
  var p = 1
  for i in range(0, k)
    p *= 2
  let low = (n * p) % 256
  let high = n // (256 // p)
  UNVERIFIED_int_to_u8(low + high)
